gates.coverage: grammar_gap == 0 and missing_lexeme == 0 — every sentence parses. NON-NEGOTIABLE.
gates.faithfulness: encoded floor 10 (reranker drifts ~1 unit even at temperature 0; observed 10-11 across draws). A1+A2 did NOT move encoded (both page-marginal). Floor catches a real regression below 10 while absorbing drift. UPDATE 2026-07-18 (history[0]/[1]): the multiword-fix baseline briefly set expected.encoded=11 from a single HIGH live draw; a deterministic REPLAY of that draw's own ranks.json gives 10 on the SAME code, so the drift-free faithfulness value is 10 (not 11) and expected.encoded is corrected back to 10. eval-parse-rate.sh gates on the exact expected.encoded, so it must be the drift-free floor (10), never a lucky peak draw. (1a) holds encoded 10->10 under replay — structural-duplicate removal cannot reduce encoded.
gates.multiplicity: total_readings GATED in eval-parse-rate.sh vs total_readings_ceiling (1500). BOTH A1 and A2 are PAGE-MARGINAL on multiplicity, shown by the drift-free cap-only A/B (--no-llm, deterministic, isolates each lexicon change): pre-A1 2869 -> +A1 2873 (+4) -> +A2 2867 (-6). Net cap-only over both: -2 of 2869 (noise). Reranked observed 1295 (drifts 1271-1295). The junk was genuine and coverage-safe to remove corpus-wide, but the gENE-class collisions were off-page and the CHV compounds were mostly single-CUI (redundant alias, dedup already collapsed). WRN-page multiplicity lives in the 11-100 buckets (~33 units): cross-lexicon sense pairs + structural PP-attachment (the x88 'impairment of a DNA repair pathway', x56 'four other RecQ DNA helicases'). That is the real lever; neither A1 nor A2 touches it. UPDATE 2026-07-18 (history[1]): the multiword-integrity + widen-ladder change PARTIALLY touches it -- deterministic cap-only 2867->2407 (-16%), reranked 1295->1126 (-13%). It collapses the ON-WIDEN compositional explosion (the x88 'a DNA repair pathway' overlap gap that forced widen->integrity-off); the BASE-CAP structural PP/coordination ambiguity still remains. UPDATE 2026-07-18 (history[0]): (1a) canonical modifier-`And` normal form takes a first bite of that base-cap ambiguity -- cap-only 2407->2347 (-60), reranked 1079->1027 (-4.8%, drift-free replay). It kills the modifier-`And` COMMUTATIVITY over-generation (a noun's compound + PP modifier conjoined in either order -> now one canonical term). REMAINING (driver 1b, deferred with scope): coordination-`And` is a DIFFERENT site (fold_conn is already left-canonical); the coord units' residual is genuine distribution-vs-single-NP scope + a coordinated-pre-nominal-modifier attachment defect (duplicated restrictions) + a skeleton-eraser artifact (cross-lexicon n/C sense counted as structure).

reproducibility.finding: temperature:0 is NOT deterministic. Two live runs of identical code against an identical store differ on ~5% of the CAPPED top-2 — the only part that reaches the parser. encoded moves +/-1 unit between runs. Do not read a one-unit change as signal.
reproducibility.the_only_exact_reproduction: scripts/measure-parse-rate.sh --replay <run>/ranks.json — replays the recorded rankings with no LLM. A replay with misses > 0 is a DIFFERENT experiment.
reproducibility.instrument_caveat: ranks.json records the RERANKER'S CANDIDATE LIST, built BEFORE lookup_span's dedup and cap. It shows what the model was ASKED, not what SEEDED. It cannot tell you how many cap slots a merge freed. (Misread three times on 2026-07-11/12.) The `sems` field makes merges visible — two senses with different labels and the SAME sem are one concept — but the pre-dedup caveat still stands.

history.note: (1a) CANONICAL MODIFIER-`And` NORMAL FORM + a drift-calibration correction to the multiword-fix baseline. Parser-only, NO reseed. Found via a new skeleton view (EIGENIUS_TRACE_SKELETONS on trace_one_sentence: erase senses -> count distinct STRUCTURAL bracketings). ROOT CAUSE (traced): the noun refine machinery (refine_conjoin / refine_attrib) built the flat-Σ restrictor `And(existing, new)` in CKY DERIVATION ORDER, so the two attachment orders of one modifier set -- `And(compound, prep_of)` vs `And(prep_of, compound)` -- emitted commutatively-distinct terms that subsume_duplicates (β-equal only) never merged. WITNESSED on 'Many cancers exhibit an impairment of a DNA repair pathway': 196 readings / 40 structural skeletons, 6 of which were pure commutative duplicates of another 6 (the PP `of a DNA repair pathway` attaches to `impairment` in ALL of them -- `of` is nominal, so there is NO verb-attachment; this unit is NOT the 'PP-attachment' the older note called it). FIX: `conjoin_canonical` flattens the associative And-tree, SORTS conjuncts by a deterministic key (pretty_term), rebuilds left-nested -> both derivations emit the byte-identical Σ, so they pack + subsume. Also unified the refinement bound var (refine_attrib `__refine_x` -> COMPOUND_X) so the canonicalization is alpha-stable across an adjective/compound mix. WITNESSED collapse: PP unit 196->170 readings / 40->34 skeletons (exactly the 6 dups); the coordination unit was UNCHANGED (its And is fold_conn, already left-canonical -- that is driver 1b, a SEPARATE deferred site). MEASURED: deterministic cap-only 2407->2347 (-60, 5 units down, ZERO per-unit regression); reranked isolated drift-free by REPLAYING one ranks.json across baseline-vs-1a code: total 1079->1027 (-4.8%), encoded 10->10 UNCHANGED (structural-duplicate removal cannot reduce encoded). Guards: dcg::rules::combinators::dispatch_tests::conjoin_canonical_is_order_independent (CI, no snapshot) + the differential oracle. DRIFT-CALIBRATION CORRECTION: history[1] set expected.encoded=11 from one HIGH live draw; the replay shows the SAME code+rankings give 10, so expected.encoded is corrected to the drift-free floor 10 (eval-parse-rate.sh gates on the exact expected.encoded, so it must be the floor, never a peak draw -- that mismatch, not a regression, is what tripped RC=2). REMAINING lever (1b, scoped + deferred, NOT a canonicalization): coordination-`And` -- genuine distribution-vs-single-NP scope + a coordinated-pre-nominal-modifier attachment defect (duplicated restrictions `And(a,a)`) + a skeleton-eraser cross-lexicon-sense artifact (n/C prefix counted as structure).

RE-BASELINE. Multiword span-integrity STRUCTURAL fix, parser-only (NO reseed). Two commits: eb0c5ab (overlap boundary-exception) + 66d84de (widen-ladder), enabled by the forest-derivation tracer b578390 (EIGENIUS_TRACE_FOREST). ROOT CAUSE (traced): the base-cap multiword-preference cut was a per-split-position veto (protected_split) that could not express OVERLAPPING multiwords. Two lexicalized multiwords sharing a token -- 'cancer cell'[0,1] cap 'cell lines'[1,2]; 'aDNA'(C0000702)[0,1] cap 'DNA repair pathway'(C1511689)[1,3] -- are mutually exclusive per derivation, so protecting each one's interior GLOBALLY vetoed the split the OTHER needed (the determiner boundary / the alternative bracketing) -> the sentence GAPPED at base cap and exploded on widen. That is the x88 'a DNA repair pathway' failure the stashed widen-ladder workaround had (88->227): its own stash message said 'the multiword doesn't compose alone' = this overlap gap. FIX (A, eb0c5ab): boundary-exception -- an interior split k is left OPEN where a DIFFERENT multiword abuts (starts at k+1 or ends at k); an ISOLATED multiword stays fully protected (its cross-span compound-pile pruning is where the value is). (A) ALONE is cap-only PAGE-NEUTRAL (2867->2865): on the WRN page almost every overlap sentence ALSO widens for a sense-cap reason (subject determiners a_subj/the_subj/many_subj rank below cap 2 -- witnessed: a_subj seeds only at cap>=4), and at widen integrity was OFF, so the overlap fix was moot there. FIX (widen-ladder, 66d84de): hold multiword-preference ON through the ENTIRE widen ladder, lifting only at the FINAL rung (cap>=SENSE_CAP_WIDEN_MAX=16 / beam>=CELL_BEAM_WIDEN_MAX=512) -- so a sentence that widens for sense-crowding keeps its compounds collapsed instead of re-exploding; coverage still falls back to the compositional splits at the last rung, grammar-gap 0. This is the half that REDUCES multiplicity; (A) is the half that makes it SAFE (without (A) it re-gaps overlaps through every rung -> the 88->227 explosion, which is why the widen-ladder was stashed as a workaround). NEITHER HALF MOVES THE PAGE ALONE. WITNESSED -- deterministic cap-only A/B (--no-llm, drift-free, isolates the code): 2867->2407 (-16%), grammar-gap 0, encoded 2 held, >100 bin 7->3; the isolated multiword 'insertion or deletion mutations' stays 16 (a rejected variant B, same-span-only suppression, blew it to 112). RERANKED (live, ONE sample, drifts ~5%): encoded 10->11, total_readings 1295->1126 (-13%), grammar-gap 0, >100 bin 1, eval-parse-rate.sh PASS. CAVEAT: the reranked delta is one sample and conflates code + temp-0 drift; the drift-free evidence is the -16% cap-only. PARTIALLY addresses the x88/x56 PP-attachment lever the A1/A2 note called untouched -- it collapses the ON-WIDEN explosion, but the BASE-CAP structural PP/coordination ambiguity remains (e.g. 'MSI occurs in colon, gastric, endometrial and ovarian cancers' rose 24->82 cap-only, but the reranker absorbs it -> NOT in the reranked >100 bin). Guards: dcg::chart::tests (5 boundary-exception unit tests, CI no-snapshot) + the differential oracle packed==unpacked (both drivers share multiword_protected_splits). REJECTED ALTERNATIVE (B): abolish the veto entirely, drop only the same-span compound rebuild -- gap-safe but too gentle, cap-only 2867->3002 (+4.7%, lost the isolated-multiword cross-span pruning); reverted.

2,410 redundant multiword CHV-only aliases dropped at import (--drop-chv-redundant). Coverage-safe (grammar-gap 0). PAGE-MARGINAL: cap-only 2873->2867 (-6, deterministic), a couple of 2-CUI compounds (dna helicase, cell death) collapsing. Same profile as A1: corpus-wide junk removal, not a page multiplicity win.

first reference. Cross-lexicon duplicates and function-word junk both present.
cross-lexicon alignment v1 (12,450 merges). readings -4.3%, encoded UNCHANGED — collapsing a duplicate freed a cap slot that the parser immediately refilled.

SENSE ELIMINATION. The ranker may now OMIT an impossible sense, the cap no longer backfills from the rejects, and 132 closed-class entries carry a real core:description (they used to render as BLANK LINES in the prompt, so the model eliminated the determiner `each` and kept UMLS's 'Each (qualifier value)'). encoded 1 -> 4, runtime 330s -> 220s. THE ONLY CHANGE THAT MOVED encoded ALL SESSION.

alignment v2 (26,690 merges, incl. the un-glossed half). readings -0.3% vs v1 — FLAT. Cross-lexicon de-duplication is DONE and is not the lever. What remains is STRUCTURAL: the worst unit is 168 readings over 93 skeletons (coordination + PP attachment), sense~1.8.

alignment v3 (38,389 merges). Two structural fixes: (1) UMLS surfaces LEMMATISED against WordNet, so plural atoms (Genes, Tumours, Therapies) now merge — their entries (e_<CUI>_0) are separate from the singular and were silently unmerged before; (2) one verdict now licenses EVERY surface of a concept, not just the judged one. 26,690 -> 38,389 merges, 51,925 entry rewrites (2.8x v2). readings 2320 -> 2237 (-3.6%), encoded UNCHANGED at 3. grammar-gap 0 held. Predicted the two pure-sense units (MSI tumours: 8->4, Germline: 3->2) would collapse to ENCODED; they dropped but did NOT reach 1. Confirms the standing verdict a THIRD time: alignment reduces reading MULTIPLICITY a few %, never reaches a SINGLE reading. The residual is structural. CAVEAT on the -3.6%: it is NOT drift-controlled — the v2 (2320) and v3 (2237) totals are separate live-reranker runs, so the delta conflates the lexicon change with temp-0 reranker drift, and cap-backfill absorbs part of the dedup (the worst unit's max went UP 128 -> 184). Direction is right, magnitude is soft; to isolate the lexicon effect, replay ONE ranks.json across both snapshots. Also: the prior -v3 measurement (encoded 4) was the STALE v2 .esl loaded under a v3 name (emit was never re-run); the emit+load two-step was fused into scripts/build-alignment-snapshot.sh, and merges.json is now built by a `lexicon-align merges` subcommand instead of an ad-hoc script.

Machine move + dcg-cleanup merge. The merge bundled a dcg module REORGANIZATION (lookup.rs -> parse/, parser.rs -> rules/combinators.rs, packed.rs -> chart/, category.rs split into rules/) with a code/data-consistency fix: conn_list, which the parser (category.rs LIST_CONN) had always CONSTRUCTED, was finally DECLARED on the lexicon:Conn inductive. That declaration changed the compiled lexicon-bootstrap content hash (e11ff807 -> 0298520a), so the 2026-07-12 snapshot no longer resumes (ManifestDrift, fail-closed) and a reseed was required. Full reseed against the post-merge bootstrap -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-15 (38,389 merges, 51,925 entry rewrites), then measured live: encoded 3, ambiguous 58, open 1, grammar-gap 0, missing-lexeme 0, runtime 257s. REPRODUCES the baseline EXACTLY, on a different machine, confirming (a) the new machine reproduces prior work and (b) the merge is behaviorally neutral on this page (dcg reorg + conn_list together). Provenance repointed from the drifted 2026-07-12 snapshot to this one; the 2026-07-12 snapshots are superseded and safe to prune.

RE-BASELINE. Definite-referential fix. Definite + demonstrative determiners denoted the existential CPS (obj_exists_sem / exists_sem) as a documented first-cut; under negation that spuriously bifurcated into wide-scope (not-exists) vs narrow-scope (exists-not) -- a REAL ambiguity for `a`/`an`, vacuous for a definite's unique referent. Fix: new axiom ontology:the (the iota / definite operator) + referential sems (subject V(the(A)); object TV(the(T), subj)); 12 definite/demonstrative entries repointed; `a`/`an`/`some` + cardinals KEEP the quantifier sems (their scope split is real). The category is unchanged (sem-only edit) so grammar-gap is unchanged by construction; both scope derivations now normalise to one term and felicity::subsume_duplicates collapses them. The bootstrap edit changed the lexicon-bootstrap content hash and invalidated the 07-15 chain -> reseed --umls-all + v3-align -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-16 (2.8 GB). Witnessed: cap-only grammar-gap 0 + missing-lexeme 0, WRN negation sentence 4->2 (1 structural skeleton, residual is a cross-lexicon `activity` sense dup); reranked encoded 7, ambiguous 54, open 1, grammar-gap 0, runtime 279s. The single traced, drift-immune signal is the WRN sentence AMBIG x2 -> ENCODED (cap-only 4->2). CAVEAT: encoded 3 -> 7 is NOT a controlled delta -- it accumulates span-integrity + the bare-mass And fix + this fix ACROSS intervening snapshot reseeds; against the last live-captured reranked run on the OLD snapshot (6914d01, encoded 7) this fix recovers the -1 the bare-mass run showed (6 -> 7). Floor set at 6 (see gates.faithfulness). Regression guards: dcg::lexicon::referential_definite_tests (CI, no snapshot) + definite_negation_collapses_referential (snapshot-gated, crates/eigenius-wordnet/tests/db_backed_encoding.rs).

RE-BASELINE. Quantifier-determiner fix. `several`/`many`/`few`/`most`/`both` were MISSING from the determiner lexicon, so `several cancers` had no quantifier reading and fell back to `several`'s WordNet gradable-ADJECTIVE entry used prenominally (`gt(deg_a, std_a)` -- the spurious 'more-several-than-standard' modifier). Two-part fix: (1) added the 5 as plural existential determiners (closed-class.esl, modeled on `some` but pl; cardinality opaque first-cut); (2) an ALWAYS-ON cross-POS prune (parse/seed.rs) that drops the open-class ADJECTIVE reading (`is_adjective_cat`, the S[adj]\NP seed) of any surface carrying a closed-class DETERMINER reading (`cat_forall`). Part 1 alone would leave determiner AND adjective (still 2); part 2 alone would gap the sentence (no quantifier reading) -- both needed. Bootstrap edit -> reseed --umls-all + v3-align -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-16-quant (2.7 GB, image rebuilt). Witnessed: cap-only grammar-gap 0 + missing-lexeme 0, total readings 2899 -> 2835 (-64, adjective readings pruned corpus-wide), `several cancers` now 1 structural skeleton (determiner; both the gt-adjective and the noun-compound gone); reranked encoded 8, ambiguous 53, open 1, grammar-gap 0, runtime 248s. Traced drift-immune signal: `MSI contributes to several cancers` AMBIG x2 -> ENCODED (+1 over the definite-fix run's 7). No collateral: `most commonly observed` (most-as-adverb) and `fewer deletion` (fewer-as-determiner) unchanged; predicative adjective uses ('the problems were several') are given up by the prune (accepted -- these are quantifiers, not gradable properties). KNOWN RESIDUAL: `few`/`most`/`both` still carry a noun-compound reading (the prune targets adjectives, not nouns); `several`/`many` are clean (no competing noun sense at the cap). Floor set at 7 (see gates.faithfulness).

RE-BASELINE. Two SEEDING fixes (parse/seed.rs, NO reseed -- snapshot unchanged), diagnosed from the reranked 2-3 bucket. (A) EVENT [33ff4a2] cap-then-dedup: the cross-lexicon concept dedup used to run BEFORE the sense cap, so a merged reranker top-2 (event-happening's WordNet sense + its UMLS twin) dropped the twin and let the cap BACKFILL a lower-ranked wrong sense (event-*circumstance*). Moving dedup AFTER the cap keeps the reranker's top-`cap` raw positions, which collapse to 1 -> 'Each event alone does not lead to cell death' encodes. (B) GENE [4400aef] elimination-through-widen: the sense-cap elimination cut applied only at BASE cap, so when a sentence WIDENED (base cap fails -- 'Germline mutations ... cause Lynch syndrome' needs cap 4 for `cause`/`mutations`' deep RANKED sense), the widen un-eliminated ALL of the reranker's rejects, re-seeding junk onto every word (`gene` got C5849123 = 'Gross Extranodal Extension' via a spurious 'gENE' NCI synonym). Making the cut hold at EVERY cap rung keeps eliminations through widen; the wrong-elimination safety is instead provided by parse_widening PASS 2 (a ranks=None widen), reached only when a NEEDED sense was wrongly eliminated -- so grammar-gap stays 0. CORRECTION: `gene` was NOT a merge gap (the real gene C0017337<->n05436752 was already merged); the earlier 'dedup gene' framing was wrong -- the junk is a different concept the reranker already eliminates, and merges.json was not the lever. VALIDATED by a deterministic REPLAY of the 2235 rankings (isolates the code from the reranker): encoded 8->10, total_readings 1991->1282 (-36%), grammar-gap 0; then CONFIRMED live at 4400aef: encoded 10, ambiguous 51, open 1, grammar-gap 0, total_readings 1286 (== replay, so the -35% multiplicity drop is structural, not drift), runtime 239s. The 2 newly-encoded are exactly 'Each event ...' and 'Germline mutations ...'. The bigger result is total_readings: the gene fix is BROAD (every widening sentence stops flooding), 101+ bin 4->1. Floor set at 9; total_readings ceiling 1500 (see gates).
